title: VeloraOS 1.10.32 - Hidden Reasoning Privacy Hotfix
releaseNotes: Stops local reasoning models from exposing internal thinking, analysis or chain-of-thought text in Chat.
Sanitizes model output server-side before it is saved and ignores dedicated Ollama reasoning fields.
Adds a frontend safety filter so previously saved chats containing leaked reasoning no longer display it.
Strips historical hidden reasoning before assistant messages are reused as context in later turns.
Preserves Cosmic Reasoning as an internal quality control without exposing private reasoning.
